Callout.Name: Assault - Bar Fight
Callout.Message: Fight outside a bar, one person on the ground.
Callout.Advisory: Several involved, staff trying to separate them.

Script.Line: He started it inside and he brought it out here.
I have had four pints. That is not a crime.
My nose is broken. So who is the victim here?

Lines.Approach: Fight outside the bar, more than two involved, and one of them is down.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
